interval.description: Tick every this long, e.g. 500ms, 10s, 5m, 1h30m, 1d (at least 10ms). The default schedule when there's no cron.

cron.description: Tick on a cron pattern: 5 fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), or 6 with seconds first; nicknames like @hourly too.

timezone.description: Time zone for cron, e.g. Europe/Berlin (IANA name).

align.description: Put interval ticks on wall-clock multiples of the interval since 1970-01-01 UTC (every 1m at :00), instead of counting from the start.

fire_on_start.description: Also tick at the start (when the plugin starts, or at start_time).

jitter.description: Delay each tick by a random amount below this; tick_time stays the scheduled time.

start_time.description: No ticks before this time (RFC 3339). An interval without align counts from it.

end_time.description: No ticks after this time (RFC 3339); then the source stops emitting.

missed.description: What happens to ticks that couldn't go out on time: skip (drop them; the next tick counts them), fire_once (one catch-up tick) or catch_up (each, up to max_catch_up).

max_catch_up.description: With missed = catch_up: at most this many missed ticks are sent.

max_late.description: With missed = skip: a tick that would go out later than this after its time is dropped.

label.description: Copied into every tick, to tell several tickers apart downstream.

confirmed.description: Wait for the hub to take each tick before the next.
